messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii**

| Month | Why it’s a good time |
|-------|----------------------|
| **April & May** | Spring brings warm, sunny days (average highs 78–84 °F / 26–29 °C) but before the peak‑season crowds. Prices on flights and hotels start to drop, and the island’s flora is in full bloom. |
| **September & October** | After the summer rush, the weather remains pleasant (highs 80–85 °F / 27–29 °C). The ocean stays warm enough for swimming, and the tourist traffic is lighter. |
| **November** | Still warm (highs 78–83 °F / 26–28 °C), but the holiday crowds have thinned. You’ll find better deals on accommodations and flights. |

### Quick weather snapshot (average highs)

| Month | Avg. High (°F) | Avg. High (°C) |
|-------|----------------|----------------|
| Jan | 82 | 28 |
| Feb | 82 | 28 |
| Mar | 81 | 27 |
| Apr | 81 | 27 |
| May | 82 | 28 |
| Jun | 84 | 29 |
| Jul | 85 | 29 |
| Aug | 85 | 29 |
| Sep | 84 | 29 |
| Oct | 83 | 28 |
| Nov | 82 | 28 |
| Dec | 82 | 28 |

*(These averages come from NOAA climate data for Honolulu.)*

### Bottom line

If you’re looking for a balance of great weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices, **April, May, September, October, or November** are your best bets. If you’re okay with higher prices and larger crowds, the peak season (June–August) still offers fantastic beach weather and plenty of events. Happy planning!
